subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
The bock diagram of a receiver system with an 
antenna is shown below. The loss factor of the 
antenna lead in cable is L = 1.5 dB. The noise figure 
and gain of different stages are shown in the 
respective blocks. 
 
 
What is the overall noise figure of the system? 
 
(a) 7.19 dB 
(b) 8.57 dB 
 
(c) 4.32 dB 
(d) 6.36 dB
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-07 (Noise In Communication).
